note: The smallest change of the three, included because it punishes padding: three requirements that genuinely need two or three stories, so a planner that emits one story per requirement plus a 'set up Redis' story and a 'migrate the api_keys table' story has produced infrastructure tasks dressed as user stories. CAP-1 is also the requirement most likely to be absorbed silently into FR-1 — counter durability is invisible until a restart, so a planner can describe the limiter correctly and never state that it persists.
